picks.reasoning: Stats are for cowards. T1 has the best individual talent on the board, and a -0.3k GD means nothing when Faker's roster takes over games by itself. Fade the crowd's GEN and BLG hype.
Tempo is everything, and KC has the biggest 15-minute lead at the tournament, +1.1k gold over 38 games. They snowball the first drakes and map control before anyone else wakes up.
Fearless punishes one-trick comfort picks, and BLG's 188 games of LPL pool-stretching plus a 3-0 over DK show a team that keeps finding new drafts when the usual picks are gone.
GEN tops the board on win rate: 74% of games, 8-1 against other regions, and a 3-0 over LYON. BLG has the bigger sample, but GEN's rates are cleaner.
Numbers say BLG and GEN, but I trust the T1 room: Faker's veterans bounced back from the DK loss, and they stay calm when it gets tense.
